article:
NVIDIA is already briefing media on DLSS 5
NVIDIA appears to be preparing the next stage of its DLSS 5 rollout. Linus Sebastian confirmed during the latest WAN Show that Linus Tech Tips has signed an embargo agreement covering DLSS 5 and already has a video prepared for publication.
The discussion followed this week’s leak of the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering library from NBA 2K27 . Linus explained that LTT can discuss information discovered independently from the leaked files, while details and demonstrations supplied directly by NVIDIA remain covered by the embargo.
“We did a video. There’s screen cap. You’ll see it once the embargo is up.”
NVIDIA officially announced DLSS 5 in March and has only committed to a fall 2026 release. The existence of an active media embargo suggests that NVIDIA is already preparing press coverage ahead of that rollout, although it does not confirm when the feature will become publicly available.
We can also tell from this that the build in the NBA game might be one of the newest ones, and the results it shows might be close to the ones that will be released officially.
LTT has already tested the leaked implementation
Linus also tested the leaked DLSS 5 library independently in Cyberpunk 2077 and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. He confirmed that the implementation exposes three models and several developer controls. These include adjustments affecting color, tone mapping and the strength of the Neural Rendering effect.
The leaked implementation is already being tested well beyond NBA 2K27. As we reported this week, modders have enabled the DLSS 5 library in more than a dozen games , while a separate patch has allowed it to run on GeForce RTX 40 series hardware . Those implementations remain experimental and are separate from NVIDIA’s embargoed demonstrations.
NVIDIA has not announced when the DLSS 5 embargo expires. Should we learn something concrete, we will let you know. Since NVIDIA launched new driver this week, I find it unlikely that DLSS 5 release is close.
